from pathlib import Path
import math
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFilter
import artifact_io

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
W,H=256,192
S=3
original=Image.open(ROOT/'first_frame.png').convert('RGB')
pixels=np.array(original)

def region(poly, blur=0):
    a=Image.new('L',(W*S,H*S),0)
    ImageDraw.Draw(a).polygon([(round(x*S),round(y*S)) for x,y in poly],fill=255)
    a=a.resize((W,H),Image.Resampling.LANCZOS)
    return a.filter(ImageFilter.GaussianBlur(blur)) if blur else a

def heal(base, selection, dx,dy):
    # Seamlessly reuse texture from an unobstructed part of the same table.
    b=np.asarray(base).astype(float)
    yy,xx=np.mgrid[:H,:W]
    src=b[np.clip(yy+dy,0,H-1),np.clip(xx+dx,0,W-1)]
    m=np.array(selection)>32
    # Dirichlet Poisson reconstruction using only the source's local gradients.
    lap=4*src-np.roll(src,1,0)-np.roll(src,-1,0)-np.roll(src,1,1)-np.roll(src,-1,1)
    v=b.copy();v[m]=src[m]
    for k in range(700):
        val=(np.roll(v,1,0)+np.roll(v,-1,0)+np.roll(v,1,1)+np.roll(v,-1,1)+lap)*.25
        v[m]=val[m]
    alpha=np.array(selection,dtype=float)[...,None]/255
    return Image.fromarray(np.uint8(np.clip(b*(1-alpha)+v*alpha,0,255)))

robot_hole=region([(0,51),(22,49),(31,47),(49,48),(55,56),(59,93),(54,102),(0,105)],1)
bg=heal(original,robot_hole,166,64)
tool_hole=region([(132,82),(150,81),(152,106),(158,142),(156,156),(124,156),(119,139),(128,123),(131,100)],1)
bg=heal(bg,tool_hole,35,0)
block_hole=region([(54,75),(77,71),(83,101),(74,105),(53,105)],.6)
empty=heal(bg,block_hole,35,34)

# Textured rigid parts, all taken from the first observation.
def sprite(poly):
    out=original.convert('RGBA');out.putalpha(region(poly,.22));return out
upper=sprite([(26,55),(29,52),(39,50),(47,51),(50,55),(51,68),(48,71),(33,74),(29,70)])
lower=sprite([(32,73),(49,70),(52,73),(55,87),(52,91),(36,93),(34,84)])
back=sprite([(25,58),(32,56),(36,84),(33,86),(29,77)])
shaft=sprite([(0,71),(29,69),(33,78),(0,81)])
wrist=sprite([(0,58),(3,58),(7,62),(9,73),(8,87),(5,95),(0,98)])
tool=sprite([(136,86),(140,84),(144,85),(147,89),(145,96),(145,133),(147,137),(146,145),(138,146),(135,140),(136,130),(136,100),(135,94)])
block=sprite([(56,78),(74,75),(78,97),(60,101),(57,91)])

# Affine pose about the observed silver tool head.
def warp(im, theta=0, center=(141,90), offset=(0,0), origin=(141,90)):
    c,s=math.cos(math.radians(theta)),math.sin(math.radians(theta))
    # world = R*(source-origin) + center + R*offset
    cx,cy=center;ox,oy=origin;dx,dy=offset
    tx=cx-c*ox+s*oy+c*dx-s*dy
    ty=cy-s*ox-c*oy+s*dx+c*dy
    # Supersampled destination, source coordinates remain original pixels.
    return im.transform((W*S,H*S),Image.Transform.AFFINE,(c/S,s/S,-c*tx-s*ty,-s/S,c/S,s*tx-c*ty),Image.Resampling.BICUBIC)

def combine(parts):
    out=Image.new('RGBA',(W*S,H*S))
    for p in parts:out.alpha_composite(p)
    return out

# Complete the cropped forearm, keeping every visible part rigid.
arm=Image.new('RGBA',(W*S,H*S))
# This extended canvas also contains material outside the field of view.
# The arm geometry is drawn in a larger local canvas then warped with the same pose.
AW,AH=520,340; AX,AY=220,80
arm_local=Image.new('RGBA',(AW*S,AH*S))
d=ImageDraw.Draw(arm_local)
def pol(points,fill):
    d.polygon([((x+AX)*S,(y+AY)*S) for x,y in points],fill=fill)
def ell(box,fill):
    d.ellipse(tuple((v+(AX if i%2==0 else AY))*S for i,v in enumerate(box)),fill=fill)
pol([(-210,68),(-7,68),(-7,84),(-210,84)],(23,28,28,255))
pol([(-210,68),(-7,68),(-7,71),(-210,71)],(46,49,45,255))
pol([(-210,81),(-7,81),(-7,84),(-210,84)],(13,18,18,255))
ell((-17,57,8,98),(22,27,26,255))
ell((-16,58,1,96),(35,39,36,255))
pol([(-10,64),(1,62),(3,88),(-9,91)],(27,31,29,255))
# inset bearing
ell((-13,66,-2,86),(20,25,24,255))


def arm_warp(theta,center):
    c,s=math.cos(math.radians(theta)),math.sin(math.radians(theta))
    cx,cy=center
    tx=cx-c*141+s*90;ty=cy-s*141-c*90
    return arm_local.transform((W*S,H*S),Image.Transform.AFFINE,
        (c,s,(-c*tx-s*ty+AX)*S,-s,c,(s*tx-c*ty+AY)*S),Image.Resampling.BICUBIC)


def shadow(scene, rgba, shift=(4,7), blur=2.5,opacity=.2):
    a=rgba.getchannel('A')
    a=a.transform(a.size,Image.Transform.AFFINE,(1,0,-shift[0]*S,0,1,-shift[1]*S),Image.Resampling.BILINEAR)
    a=a.filter(ImageFilter.GaussianBlur(blur*S)).point(lambda v:int(v*opacity))
    sh=Image.new('RGBA',a.size,(32,30,23,0));sh.putalpha(a)
    scene.alpha_composite(sh)

# head coordinates, tool/gripper rotation, jaw opening, tool attached, cube offset.
poses=[
    (56,74,0,0,False,0,0),
    (61,75,0,1,False,0,0),
    (74,78,0,2.5,False,0,0),
    (95,83,0,3.5,False,0,0),
    (119,87,0,3.5,False,0,0),
    (138,90,0,3,False,0,0),
    (141,90,0,.6,True,0,0),
    (143,81,7,.6,True,0,0),
    (143,65,24,.6,True,0,0),
    (138,47,43,.6,True,0,0),
    (127,36,55,.6,True,0,0),
    (119,43,60,.6,True,0,0),
    (113,54,60,.6,True,0,0),
    (111,56,61,.6,True,-3,1.5),
    (114,43,58,.6,True,-5,2.5),
    (120,37,56,.6,True,-5.5,3),
    (123,39,55,.6,True,-5.5,3),
    (122,40,56,.6,True,-5.5,3),
    (122,40,56,.6,True,-5.5,3),
    (122,40,56,.6,True,-5.5,3),
]
frames=[np.array(original)]
for i,p in enumerate(poses[1:],1):
    hx,hy,theta,op,held,bx,by=p
    # Gripper contact reference is the right-hand tip, originally (56,74).
    # Before grasp, reference center travels to the original tool's head.
    center=(hx,hy)
    gripper_center=(hx,hy) if held else (hx,hy)
    # Source gripper is shifted by (85,16) relative to the tool's pose.
    offset=(85,16)
    geomcenter=(hx-85,hy-16)
    # A common rigid transform for both jaw parts, wrist, and forearm.
    # Tool and hand share a fixed relation after closure.
    c,s=math.cos(math.radians(theta)),math.sin(math.radians(theta))
    gc=(hx-c*85+s*16,hy-s*85-c*16)
    parts=[arm_warp(theta,gc),warp(wrist,theta,gc),warp(shaft,theta,gc),warp(back,theta,gc),
           warp(upper,theta,gc,offset=(0,-op)),warp(lower,theta,gc,offset=(0,op))]
    hand=combine(parts)
    toolpose=warp(tool,theta,center) if held else warp(tool)
    scene=(empty if bx or by else bg).resize((W*S,H*S),Image.Resampling.BICUBIC).convert('RGBA')
    if bx or by:
        cube=warp(block,-3,(67+bx,87+by),origin=(67,87))
        shadow(scene,cube,(2,3),1.5,.12)
        scene.alpha_composite(cube)
    rise=max(0,90-hy) if held else 0
    shadow(scene,hand,(4+rise*.10,7+rise*.10),2.8+rise*.025,.23)
    shadow(scene,toolpose,(3+rise*.15,5+rise*.16),1.3+rise*.035,.19 if held else .13)
    scene.alpha_composite(hand)
    # The protruding metal head and the whole black/yellow handle remain visible.
    scene.alpha_composite(toolpose)
    out=scene.convert('RGB').resize((W,H),Image.Resampling.LANCZOS)
    frames.append(np.array(out,dtype=np.uint8))

frames=np.stack(frames)
artifact_io.save(frames,ROOT)
bg.save(ROOT/'.tmp/background.png')
# Detailed timeline for local quality inspection.
sheet=Image.new('RGB',(W*5,H*4),(24,24,24))
for i,f in enumerate(frames):sheet.paste(Image.fromarray(f),(i%5*W,i//5*H))
sheet.save(ROOT/'.tmp/timeline.png')

from pathlib import Path
import base64
import json
import wave

import numpy as np
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw


def save(frames, case_dir, audio=None):
    case_dir = Path(case_dir)
    frames = np.asarray(frames)
    path = case_dir / "task_spec.json"
    spec = json.loads(path.read_text()) if path.is_file() else {}
    n, h, w, fps = (spec.get("frames", 20), spec.get("height", 144), spec.get("width", 256), spec.get("fps", 4))
    assert frames.shape == (n, h, w, 3) and frames.dtype == np.uint8, frames.shape
    audio_spec = spec.get("audio")
    audio_url = None
    if audio_spec:
        samples = round(n / fps * audio_spec["sample_rate"])
        pcm = np.asarray(audio)
        if pcm.ndim == 1:
            pcm = pcm[:, None]
        assert pcm.shape == (samples, audio_spec["channels"]) and pcm.dtype == np.int16, (pcm.shape, pcm.dtype)
        with wave.open(str(case_dir / "audio.wav"), "wb") as handle:
            handle.setnchannels(audio_spec["channels"])
            handle.setsampwidth(2)
            handle.setframerate(audio_spec["sample_rate"])
            handle.writeframes(pcm.astype("<i2").tobytes())
        audio_url = "data:audio/wav;base64," + base64.b64encode((case_dir / "audio.wav").read_bytes()).decode()
    values = frames.astype(np.uint32)
    packed = (values[:, :, :, 0] << 16) | (values[:, :, :, 1] << 8) | values[:, :, :, 2]
    tensor = packed.transpose(1, 2, 0)
    np.savez_compressed(case_dir / "pixels.npz", pixels=tensor)

    folder = case_dir / "frames"
    folder.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    for index, frame in enumerate(frames):
        Image.fromarray(frame).save(folder / f"{index:02d}.png")

    sheet = Image.new("RGB", (w * 4, (h + 21) * 2), (25, 28, 35))
    draw = ImageDraw.Draw(sheet)
    for index, frame_index in enumerate(np.linspace(0, n - 1, 8).round().astype(int)):
        x, y = (index % 4) * w, (index // 4) * (h + 21)
        draw.text((x + 5, y + 3), f"frame {frame_index:02d} · {frame_index / fps:.2f}s", fill="white")
        sheet.paste(Image.fromarray(frames[frame_index]), (x, y + 21))
    sheet.save(case_dir / "inspection.png")

    transition = Image.new("RGB", (w * 4, h * 2 + 21), (25, 28, 35))
    draw = ImageDraw.Draw(transition)
    for index, frame_index in enumerate(min(i, n-1) for i in range(4)):
        x = index * w
        draw.text((x + 5, 4), f"frame {frame_index:02d} · {frame_index / fps:.2f}s", fill="white")
        transition.paste(Image.fromarray(frames[frame_index]), (x, 21))
        transition.paste(Image.fromarray(frames[frame_index]).resize((w, h), Image.Resampling.NEAREST), (x, h + 21))
    transition.save(case_dir / "transition_check.png")

    encode = lambda array: base64.b64encode(np.asarray(array, dtype="<u4").tobytes()).decode()
    deltas = []
    for index in range(1, n):
        current = packed[index].reshape(-1)
        previous = packed[index - 1].reshape(-1)
        positions = np.flatnonzero(current != previous)
        packet = []
        if len(positions):
            bounds = np.r_[0, np.flatnonzero(np.diff(positions) > 1) + 1, len(positions)]
            for start, end in zip(bounds[:-1], bounds[1:]):
                offset = int(positions[start])
                count = int(end - start)
                packet.extend([offset, count])
                packet.extend(current[offset:offset + count].tolist())
        deltas.append(encode(packet))
    data = {
        "id": case_dir.name,
        "width": w, "height": h, "frames": n, "fps": fps, "audio": audio_url,
        "first": encode(packed[0].reshape(-1)),
        "deltas": deltas,
        "caption": (case_dir / "prompt.txt").read_text().strip(),
    }
    template = (Path(__file__).parent / "player_template.html").read_text()
    payload = json.dumps(data, separators=(",", ":"), ensure_ascii=False).replace("<", "\\u003c")
    (case_dir / "index.html").write_text(template.replace("__ID__", case_dir.name).replace("__DATA__", payload))

def warp(im, theta=0, center=(141,90), offset=(0,0), origin=(141,90)):
    c,s=math.cos(math.radians(theta)),math.sin(math.radians(theta))
    # world = R*(source-origin) + center + R*offset
    cx,cy=center;ox,oy=origin;dx,dy=offset
    tx=cx-c*ox+s*oy+c*dx-s*dy
    ty=cy-s*ox-c*oy+s*dx+c*dy
    # Supersampled destination, source coordinates remain original pixels.
    return im.transform((W*S,H*S),Image.Transform.AFFINE,(c/S,s/S,-c*tx-s*ty,-s/S,c/S,s*tx-c*ty),Image.Resampling.BICUBIC)

def combine(parts):
    out=Image.new('RGBA',(W*S,H*S))
    for p in parts:out.alpha_composite(p)
    return out

def shadow(scene, rgba, shift=(4,7), blur=2.5,opacity=.2):
    a=rgba.getchannel('A')
    a=a.transform(a.size,Image.Transform.AFFINE,(1,0,-shift[0]*S,0,1,-shift[1]*S),Image.Resampling.BILINEAR)
    a=a.filter(ImageFilter.GaussianBlur(blur*S)).point(lambda v:int(v*opacity))

    scene.alpha_composite(sh)
